architecture_change.superseded_research_plan: R6-WP509-CAND-AGENTEXIT E3 V1 held-out A/B as preregistered before WP509 G2 acceptance
architecture_change.reason: Arm A changed materially after preregistration: WP509 G2 added/accepted stronger deterministic rumination-exit and evaluator-lineage semantics.

current_architecture_interpretation: Do not add a second rumination/exit control plane.
WP509 G2 remains the sole current deterministic rumination-exit evaluator at its admitted repository-component scope.

If later evidence supports an AgentExit-derived residual, distill only explicit evidence-delta/progress inputs or rules into/through the existing WP509 evaluator and retain existing transition authority.
NEGATIVE must remain fresh evidence rather than being collapsed into NONE; UNKNOWN must remain distinct from NONE; neither recurrence nor progress heuristics may mint completion or world truth.

residual_hypothesis.statement: Explicit typed evidence_delta_kind POSITIVE|NEGATIVE|NONE|UNKNOWN plus progress_delta may reduce redundant continuation beyond WP509 G2 while preserving required OBSERVE/ASK/WAIT/DEFER_HOLD recovery paths.
residual_hypothesis.counterhypothesis: WP509 G2 already captures almost all practical exit benefit with fewer state variables and less threshold/error surface.
residual_hypothesis.falsifier: A deterministic held-out residual-over-G2 A/B shows no meaningful incremental redundant-transition reduction, or shows premature disengagement/observation starvation, causal-identity weakening, or higher decision overhead than saved work.

resource_implication: Likely cheaper and simpler than importing AgentExit or introducing another controller because the only surviving research target is a narrow typed residual within the existing WP509 path.
next_exact_action: Only if this residual remains high-value after reentry, atomically claim E3_CLAIM_REPRODUCED_PROGRESS_AWARE_EXIT_GATE_RESIDUAL_OVER_WP509_G2_V2 and preregister exact G2 source/config plus held-out deterministic fixtures before execution. Otherwise retire AgentExit as a conceptual donor whose main stopping value is already subsumed by WP509 G2.
